project.description:
Rolls back an S3 object to a specified prior version by downloading the requested object version and re-uploading it to the same key as the new latest version.
Intended for large versioned objects where direct S3 copy rollback is not suitable. Uses an assumed IAM role to access the target S3 object.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BUCKET
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Name of the S3 bucket containing the versioned object to roll back. Example: avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: KEY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Full S3 object key to roll back. Example: recover_adult/completed/phs003463/phs003463_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VERSION_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Exact S3 version ID to restore from object version history. Example: B5wYdMeKcBOvGFIoVF_0Eb6KXqfEpr_i

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
: "${BUCKET:?Must provide BUCKET}" : "${KEY:?Must provide KEY}" : "${VERSION_ID:?Must provide VERSION_ID}"
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-rollback}" WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}/rollback-work}"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
assume_role() { local role_arn="$1" local session_name="$2" local duration="${3:-3600}"
local creds_json creds_json="$(aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name")"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(echo "$creds_json" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')"
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(echo "$creds_json" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')"
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(echo "$creds_json" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')" }
FILE_NAME="$(basename "$KEY")" LOCAL_FILE="${WORKDIR}/${FILE_NAME}"
echo "Rolling back s3://${BUCKET}/${KEY} to version: ${VERSION_ID}" echo "Assuming role: ${ROLE_ARN}"
assume_role "$ROLE_ARN" "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" 3600
echo "Checking that requested version exists..." if ! aws s3api head-object \ --bucket "$BUCKET" \ --key "$KEY" \ --version-id "$VERSION_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: Version does not exist or is not accessible." echo "Bucket: $BUCKET" echo "Key: $KEY" echo "Version ID: $VERSION_ID" exit 1 fi
echo "Downloading requested version to: $LOCAL_FILE" aws s3api get-object \ --bucket "$BUCKET" \ --key "$KEY" \ --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \ "$LOCAL_FILE" >/dev/null
if [ ! -s "$LOCAL_FILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: Downloaded file is missing or empty: $LOCAL_FILE" exit 1 fi
echo "Uploading rollback object as new latest version..." aws s3 cp "$LOCAL_FILE" "s3://${BUCKET}/${KEY}"
echo "Rollback complete."
